title: Tournament: sign-up -> quarter -> semi -> final -> win -> South Bridge objective
_comment: Transcribed from ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md section B (span), section E.1 (CB-03, CB-09's journey instance), section E.5 (objectives `tournament_enter` and `tournament_win`), section G (GF-04-TOURN-01/02/03, GF-14-COMBAT-03, GF-14-COMBAT-09) and section H (S04 is one of the mandatory 0.5 Hz continuous-evidence segments).
_comment_rounds: data/config/tournament.json's rounds are quarter (Mira), semi (Tam), final (Oskar), all staged at the tournament ground (20,12). Section L.6 T10 is the transition this segment crosses three times: dialogue -> fight -> bracket update, 'bracket advances exactly one round; re-entry offers next round only'.

steps.title: how this segment is entered

args.text: §B: this segment's entry save is `S03-exit`. The three steps below are the handoff's own mechanics: the live save directory is emptied first so the title's Load list has exactly one non-empty slot and auto-focuses it (`title_screen.gd` focuses the FIRST non-empty slot), then slot 4 is seeded from the run directory, then the load is driven through the production title-screen Load path by synthetic input. §B names the seed and the Load path; the wipe is not named there and is recorded here as an added mechanical step, needed because an autosave left in slot 0 would take the auto-focus and the segment would load the wrong state.

steps.expected: a note event carries this observation into events.jsonl

steps.title: §E.5 nav note -- tournament_enter

args.text: §E.5 navigation record, objective 11/24 `tournament_enter`. Wording: 'Enter the village tournament.' It names WHAT and a WHERE only as specific as 'the village'. Player-visible information: the painted tournament board stands in the practice arena's own clearing north of the square (data/config/tournament.json's `board`, facing back toward the square so a player walking up from the well reads it head-on), and the player has already fought Bryn on that ground. Route decision: walk north from the square to the cleared arena, because the board is the only thing in the village that names a tournament. Reasoned from GF-03-VILLAGE-02 and GF-18-MAP-01 (both S03). Operator: record whether the board was legible before it was reached, and the time to the decision.

steps.title: §B save handoff

args.text: §B: 'each journey segment ends by saving to a dedicated slot through the production Save tab and copying the resulting `user://` slot file into the run directory (`saves/<segment>-exit.json`)'. The steps below are that save, driven as a player drives it -- the pause shell, five RB presses to the Save tab, focus down to slot 4, and the slot's own Save button. `save_out` afterwards only copies the artefact; it saves nothing itself. §B also branches X04 (combat lab) from this file.
